quality.evals_agents_check_cause: Most likely cause is one of the alarm guide's causes: {n}/{total}
quality.evals_agents_check_minutes: Repair time taken from the guide: {n}/{total}

quality.evals_agents_desc: The deployed agent code with real Gemini calls, run on in-memory records whose right answer is known. These are test scenarios, not factory data.
quality.evals_agents_maintenance_desc: 6 alarm codes, each as a first stop and as a repeat stop. Median {s} s per work order.
quality.evals_agents_method: Run on {date} with evals/agents/run_agent_evals.py. The cause check is judged by {judge}; every other check is exact.
quality.evals_agents_traceback_desc: 4 failed units with a known root-cause step, including one with no recorded cause and one with a misleading second mistake. Median {s} s.
quality.evals_estimate_text: About {one_shift} per machine per month for one shift, or {full_time} running 24/7.
quality.evals_estimate_title: Model cost on a normal line
quality.evals_footer: Inspection images and labels: {dataset}, {license}. Generated media is never used as evidence.
quality.evals_inspection_intro: {scored} test images across {categories} product categories of the VisA benchmark. Default mode: Gemini Flash-Lite compares each part with 3 known-good references, and Gemini Flash confirms suspected defects.
quality.evals_inspection_intro_failed: {scored} test images across {categories} product categories of the VisA benchmark ({failed} not yet scored). Default mode: Gemini Flash-Lite compares each part with 3 known-good references, and Gemini Flash confirms suspected defects.
quality.evals_live_desc: Successful calls to the deployed API in the last 90 days, from BigQuery. Includes our own testing and load-test traffic.
quality.evals_live_empty: No calls to the deployed API in the last 90 days.
quality.evals_machines_desc: Simulated machines on a computer screen (the test bench) with a seeded fault schedule, filmed by a real phone camera. Every stop, alarm and clear is logged as ground truth with server timestamps and matched to what Machine Watch detected.
quality.evals_machines_none: No soak run has been scored yet. Results will appear here, with detection rate, detection delay, false alarms and model cost per machine.
quality.evals_median_time_per_call: Median time per call: screen {screen}, confirm {confirm} ({note})
quality.evals_per_image_and_prices: Per-image results: {file}. Prices: Gemini list prices per 1M tokens (Flash introductory price until 31 Dec 2026). Try it yourself in the {gallery}.
quality.evals_subtitle: Every number is labelled LIVE, HOME RIG or PUBLIC DATA.
quality.gallery_banner_desc: Test the live Gemini multimodal inspection engine against authentic industrial images from the VisA dataset. Labels are concealed until you inspect the part to verify hit and miss decisions honestly without bias.
quality.gallery_error_load: Failed to load VisA benchmark gallery items.
quality.gallery_footer_tagline: TAKUMI • Dual-Stage Visual Quality Inspection Engine
quality.inspect_decision_gate_desc: AI informs, people decide. Requires supervisor authorization.
